method: Primary reviewer read all sixteen final answers and checked the relevant source paths. This is a limited coverage and claim review, not independent blind scoring or proof of equal semantic quality.

rubric.architecture: Entry points, proxy/native transforms, separate control plane, dashboard, desktop/client integration, data flow and supported risks.
rubric.request-flow: Entry, conditional account and operator authentication, routing, transformation, forwarding, usage reporting and supported failure boundary.
rubric.savings-accounting: Observed provider usage versus local/counterfactual estimates, receipt replay/deduplication and separation from main inference counts.
rubric.focused-control: Discovery versus lookup/direct source, coverage and verification limits, file-scoped receipt exclusion.

sharedCaveats: Both accounting answers in each repetition correctly describe main analytics filtering. None identifies the separate /keys request counter exception at api/analytics.py:330; the main analytics filter is at line 171.
Citation existence is checked separately by the analyzer; a valid location alone does not verify a claim.
No major unsupported claim was identified in this limited review; this is not an exhaustive code audit.
